profile.headline: Software Engineer in NYC
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary: Highly skilled full-stack engineer with 4+ years of experience and strong problem solving skills who writes clean, scalable code. Well-versed in FE/BE web frameworks, cloud technology, and system design.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Designed and deployed a RAG-based AI customer support system leveraging Genkit and Gemini, significantly reducing support ticket volume by 30%

- Owned end-to-end design and deployment of AI-driven multimodal meal and recipe generation, driving 1,000+ user-generated meals within the first week of launch

- Architected an event-driven notification system through SQS-triggered Lambda functions serving notifications to 4,000+ users, increasing app engagement by 30% and user retention by 23%

- Deployed and configured Snowflake Openflow to orchestrate secure, near-real-time data ingestion from PostgreSQL into Snowflake, enabling downstream analytics and reporting

- Built a real-time data pipeline linking Shopify, Salesforce, UPS, and Braze; streamlining cross-platform transactions and data analytics enabling real-time visibility across 4 platforms

ShoBizzy - Cloud-native social networking and production/show business app

- Implemented a sophisticated candidate search algorithm for high quality matches between candidates and open positions
